units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 5:4">Sabb. V, 4</cite> <he>בר׳ שבין קרניה</he> with the strap between her horns.
<cite ref="Menachot 35b:4">Men. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ דתפלין</he> the thong of the T’fillin.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:18">Num. R. s. 16</cite> <he>לתינוק שסרח ולקה בר׳ … מזכירין לו הר׳ וכ׳</he> like a child that did some mischief and was punished with a strap, and when they want to frighten it, they mention the strap with which it was punished; <he>כך היה עמלק ר׳ רעה וכ׳</he> so was Amalek the bad lash for Israel; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 18 <he>מעולם רְצוּעַת מרדות וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="T00977"><he>רצועה</he></cite>) Amalek was at all times the strap of chastisement for Israel.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:12">Macc. III, 12</cite> (<cite ref="Makkot 22b:10">22ᵇ</cite>) <he>ור׳ בידו של וכ׳</he> and he (the beadle) held in his hand a lash of calf-skin, which was twisted doubly, and two (thinner) straps were going up and down (were plaited) through it (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:12:4">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ</cite> top <he>בעל הר׳</he> the strap-bearer, v. <cite ref="T00993"><he>רַצְעָן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 12a">Yoma 12ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ור׳ היתה יוצאה מחלקו וכ׳</he> a strip of land went forth from Judah’s lot and entered into Benjamin’s territory, and on this the Temple was built; a. fr.—Pl. <he>רְצוּעוֹת</he>. Macc. l. c. <he>ושתי ר׳</he> (not <he>ושני</he>), v. supra.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 77:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVII</cite> <he>עשר ר׳ אתה לוקה</he> thou art to receive ten lashes.

senses.gloss: (trnsf.) restriction; הותרה הר׳ [the strap is untied,] the restriction is removed.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9:1">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> (ref. to <he>שמח וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9:1">ib.</cite>) <he>הותרה הר׳ לית דין וכ׳</he> is every restraint removed? is there no justice and no judge?; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:3:1">ib. to I, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:1">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, beg.; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:5:3">Y. Bicc. I, 64ᵃ</cite>; Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᵇ top <he>הואיל והותרה הר׳ יכ׳</he> since the restriction has been removed (by usage), I am likewise permitted to marry her.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:5:6">Y. Sot. VII, end, 22ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
